package.description: A timer that runs your scenario

en-US.description: A timer that runs your scenario
en-US.longDescription: A versatile schedule timer for Windows with a dial face and click-to-seek. Build nested scenarios of any complexity (pomodoro, tabata and more) — repeats, preparation countdowns. Add your own sounds for events. Run the same timer for different projects — on stop you get time per period and a total. No install, no accounts: an `exe` plus a single config file. For focused work, workouts and anything that runs on a schedule.
en-US.name: Schedule Timer
